::: {#sol-cutoff-choice}

Every rule of the form
"a 1 when the center ink is above $\param$, and a 0 otherwise",
one rule for each number $\param$.
The number $\param$ that picks one rule out of this set is the rule's one [parameter](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter).
A deep network picks one function out of a much larger set, with many [parameters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter) instead of one.

:::
